description: SERIAL DOUBTED - Aerial Visuals gives 66-0831 with c/n 5314 but FY66 US Army Hueys run 66-15000 to 66-17138 and 66-0831 does not sit in any UH-1 block known to this pass; the c/n 5314 is consistent with a Bell 205 airframe so the aircraft is real but the serial is probably a transcription error; recorded here so it is not lost - verify by reading the data plate or the post's dedication plaque
Carried to American Legion Post 79 Massena on the US Army display-helicopter loan list
